authority.statement: The notice and locator grant no permission or authority.

boundaries: This notice grants no implementation, execution, authority, effect, ontology-promotion, deployment, or production authority.
A transport acknowledgement is not journal acceptance, accepted Work history, or proof of a business effect.
Authority references and adapter-admission verdicts remain non-authorizing evidence with authority_effect:none.
An unknown external-effect outcome requires reconciliation and must never trigger automatic Work or effect retry.
The X-Ray is an explanatory candidate projection and does not mutate ONTOLOGY.md, ontology.json, nodes, relations, or promotion status.

from.label: Codex RWO refinement and X-Ray session

key_points: TransportNeutralWorkProtocolAdapterContract@candidate-2 separates CommandDeliveryPort, EventIngressPort, TransportDeliveryAttempt, and JournalAcceptancePort while preserving canonical message identity.

Transport reconnect, redelivery, known pre-accept same-message retry, unknown delivery reconciliation, new Work Attempt, replay, and uncertain external-effect reconciliation are distinct treatments with distinct owners.
Capability manifests are claims; adapter admission requires current evidence bound to the exact implementation, configuration, manifest, requirements, owner, and validity epoch tuple.
The RWO X-Ray now exposes the adapter truth boundary as a removable candidate layer without changing the current ontology graph.
The 30 scenarios are design cases with zero runtime executions; delegated reviewers inspected the frozen source and seed rather than the later Candidate-2 artifact.

Review an evidence-backed candidate delta only after contract validation; do not promote from prose or X-Ray evidence alone.
Require exact-tuple conformance evidence before admitting any gRPC, socket, Redis, managed-bus, in-memory, or future custom adapter.
